name: 火斑鳩

similarSpecies.distinction: 灰斑鳩體型較大、尾較長，頭身素淡粉灰且頸後有黑半環；火斑鳩雄鳥體型較小、尾短，身體大部分呈紅粉色、頭灰藍。雌火斑鳩與灰斑鳩雌性羽色相似，體型及尾長有助區分。
珠頸斑鳩較大、尾較長，頸側深色斑佈滿白點；火斑鳩雄鳥較細短尾、身體紅粉且頸後為狹窄黑半環，雌鳥則全身較均勻灰褐。

rangeMap.note: Partial broad native-range country overview: from Pakistan east through India and Southeast Asia to the Philippines, south to Singapore; widespread in central and southern China. Highlights are broad context only, not nationwide occupancy or exact range polygons. Hong Kong passage and winter records are described separately and are not a distinct resident breeding population.

sources.use: Full HKBWS account read (chunks 0–1): Category I, common passage migrant especially autumn and scarce winter visitor mainly Deep Bay; summer records increasing but no evidence of HK breeding. Male 21–23 cm, compact/short-tailed, pinkish-red upperparts and underparts, pale grey head, black hind collar, dark flight feathers, grey rump/uppertail, white undertail coverts and extensive white undertail tips. Female buffy-grey with black hind collar, similar in plumage to female Eurasian Collared Dove but smaller with markedly shorter tail; juveniles dull brown and lack collar. Global IUCN LC, trend decreasing. Native range from Pakistan across India and Southeast Asia to Philippines/Singapore; China range central/south; China/HK taxon S. t. humilis.

Cornell eBird/Merlin account: LC, sexually dimorphic; male reddish with bluish-gray head, female brown overall; both sexes with dark collar. Open country and agriculture; female may be confused with collared-doves but smaller with shorter tail.

Full HKBWS account read (chunks 0–1): Eurasian Collared Dove comparison. Larger/bulkier and longer-tailed; pale pinkish-grey unmarked body with nape half-collar, ruby-red iris, black bill, dull red legs; especially similar in plumage to female Red Collared Dove, but distinctly larger and longer-tailed.
Full HKBWS Spotted Dove account read: 31 cm, slender relatively long tail, pinkish-grey underparts and dark grey neck patch covered in white spots; orange iris and grey bill; comparison only.

notes: Main image depicts adult male: the species is strongly sexually dimorphic; females are buffy grey and resemble female Eurasian Collared Dove, but are smaller and markedly shorter-tailed. Juveniles lack the collar.
Hong Kong Category I records describe passage migrant and scarce winter visitor; no confirmed local breeding. Do not imply the global IUCN LC assessment means locally common.
